name: PostEx HR Portal
description: Production-grade enterprise HR onboarding and governance portal featuring 3-layer authorization (Role defaults, User overrides with mandatory justifications, and Zonal RLS), Phase 6 Super Admin portal with global metrics, attention summary, Organization CRUD (Zones, Branches, Departments, Designations), 5-Category Custom Access matrix, and non-overrideable Audit Trails; plus Zonal HR Governance portal with regional workload tracking, delayed queue step-in directives, branch manager assignments, and compliance reporting.
